narrative.northStar: The Sovereign Bond & P&L Audit Prospectus
narrative.overview: VÉRTICE Partners rejects the generic management-consulting aesthetic of stock office photography, soft SaaS cards, and vague aspirational slogans. Instead, the entire interface is constructed as an institutional financial monograph and operational audit ledger.
keyCharacteristics: Architectural 12-column prospectus spreads divided by exposed 1px hairline rules (#0C1512 and #CFC8B8).
High-authority editorial serif headings (Libre Caslon Text) paired with institutional Public Sans body copy and JetBrains Mono tabular figures.
Zero rounded card bloat (0px border radius across all ledger tables, buttons, and inputs).
Linked cascade financial simulation (Miura-fold propagation) and live telemetry cycling at rest.

rules.name: The Ledger Integrity Rule
rules.body: Never use gradients, glowing neon accents, or translucent glass blur. Authority comes from flat cotton-paper grounds contrasted against solid #134E3A ink blocks and crisp #0C1512 rules.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings (h1-h4) always lead their container directly. Never place a small kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.

rules.name: The Engraved Border Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is communicated through border weight (1px internal hairline vs. 2px section header rule) and surface tone shifts rather than drop shadows.

dos: Do present services and case studies as structured specification rows and before/after P&L reconciliation tables.
Do label all synthetic or illustrative financial demonstrations explicitly with provenance notices.
Do provide explicit Skeleton loading, Error alert, and Empty filter states for data views and forms.
donts: Don't place kickers or eyebrow labels above headings (h1-h4).
Don't use 3-column equal-height icon cards or nested cards.
Don't use emojis or unstyled browser defaults for scrollbars, text selection, or form validation.
